description: Direction to requirements: PR/FAQs, strategy frameworks, OKRs, business cases, interviews, PRDs, journey maps, and success measurement.

first-value.starter-task: Pressure-test a product idea before anyone builds it
first-value.starter-prompt: Write a PR/FAQ for a feature that lets customers pause their subscription for up to three months instead of cancelling.
first-value.verification: prfaq returns a launch press release, a customer FAQ and an internal FAQ that names the hard questions.
first-value.recovery: If prfaq does not activate, ask for it by name ("use prfaq") and check that its folder exists in your skills folder (`~/.claude/skills/` by default).

journey.when: You are deciding what to build and need a requirement a human has agreed to before design starts.
you_bring: the feature idea or problem and who it is for
the stakeholders you can talk to
interview notes or evidence you already have
journey.time: 1–2 hours of working time, plus the interviews themselves

steps.you_do: Describe the feature idea and list the stakeholders.
steps.you_get: An interview kit per stakeholder with up to seven questions ranked by how much the answer changes the design, at least one disconfirming question each, and an assumptions ledger.

steps.you_do: Paste the interview notes once you have run the interviews.
steps.you_get: One brief with every field tagged explicit, implied, inferred or missing, quoting the source.
steps.decide: Resolve the missing fields yourself; the PRD must not invent them.

steps.you_get: A PRD with an evidence-backed problem statement, numbered MoSCoW requirements, non-goals, and a success line per goal.

steps.you_do: Run it on the PRD, then take the result to whoever owns the decision.
steps.you_get: A severity-tagged critique of the PRD with a verdict and a fix for each finding.
steps.decide: Gate G0, a human call: PROCEED, PROCEED WITH CONDITIONS, REVISE (back to the brief), RECONSIDER (wrong problem) or BLOCKED.

steps.you_do: Once the PRD is ratified, ask how you will know the feature worked.
steps.you_get: One primary metric with baseline, target and timeframe, guardrail metrics, the events to instrument, and a decision rule if the target is missed.

journey.you_end_with: Interview kits, a tagged brief, a ratified PRD, and a measurement plan agreed before anyone builds.
